name: 20646 · La Plata, MD
findings: ZIP 20646 (La Plata) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20646 (La Plata) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
